answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake locked for a full epoch, and to build a public reputation signal from verified work history before it can transact. A brand-new identity starts on a narrow ledge: it may only take small jobs, and its stake is slashed if peers flag it as a duplicate. Like crossing a tundra in winter, spawning thousands of fake identities becomes slow and expensive, because each copy must fund its own stake and earn its own history, so a Sybil swarm costs more than the value it could extract.
